random_forest.pros: Highly interpretable Gini feature importance, robust against small sample sizes, no overfitting on static topographical features (slope, elevation).
random_forest.cons: Lacks temporal memory; relies on engineered rolling aggregations (24h, 7d).

lstm_neural_network.pros: Captures progressive soil saturation curves and antecedent precipitation lags over multiple weeks without manual feature engineering.
lstm_neural_network.cons: Requires dense 10+ year hourly telemetry stations from KSNDMC, higher compute, prone to overfitting with sparse extreme disaster events.

conclusion: Random Forest Ensemble remains the production baseline due to high reliability and interpretability; LSTM is validated as an advanced extension for continuous sensor telemetries.
